verdict.rationale: Helicone's core runs headlessly by design: requests flow through the AI Gateway via the OpenAI SDK with automatic logging (helicone-docs-2, helicone-docs-34). It also documents a REST request-query API with curl examples and a published OpenAPI spec (helicone-docs-15, helicone-docs-32, helicone-probe-3), registrable webhooks for automating workflows (helicone-docs-9), and Docker Compose self-hosting (helicone-docs-20). However, nothing documents CI pipeline usage, and prompt building and versioning are described as UI/Playground-driven (helicone-docs-46). Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation guides or examples, an official CLI, headless management of prompts, evals, and config, and independent hands-on reports of CI use.
